mechanism: Esomeprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing erythromycin metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations; additionally, elevated gastric pH from PPI use may reduce erythromycin absorption.
action: Monitor for erythromycin toxicity (nausea, arrhythmias, QT prolongation); consider alternative antimicrobial or PPI, or dose adjustment of erythromycin if clinically necessary.
